Title: LSJ- Rise of the Nephtali and Black Hand Ritual

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
If one of my vampires has the title of Nephtali, then someone uses
Black Hand Ritual to burn the Rise of the Nephtali card, what happens
to the Nephtali title? Is it still stealable?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
XZealot schrieb:

> If one of my vampires has the title of Nephtali, then someone uses
> Black Hand Ritual to burn the Rise of the Nephtali card, what happens
> to the Nephtali title? Is it still stealable?

IANLSJ but no, the vampire currently being a Liason keeps the title but
no other vampire can steal it since that was a "feature" provided by the
event.
